profile.name: ROSBridge WebSocket连接组件
profile.description: 用于与ROSBridge服务器建立并维护WebSocket通信的非物理软件组件，可在实验系统中发送字符串消息、接收消息，并将收到的数据分发给已注册的回调函数。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component that establishes and maintains WebSocket communication with a ROSBridge server, used in lab systems to send string messages, receive incoming messages, and dispatch received data to registered callbacks.

registry.name: Open Robotics Rosbridge Setup
registry.description: Rosbridge WS Connection是由Open Robotics (ROS)生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭、打开、设备连接、运行。支持Signal, Slot, addCallback等操作。
